content.text:
Based on the Mistral documentation:

**Supported Models:**
Currently, only **`mistral-medium-latest`** and **`mistral-large-latest`** are supported for agents in the Agents API. The documentation notes that support for more models will be enabled soon. ([Agents Introduction - Which models are supported?](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/agents/introduction#which-models-are-supported))

**Handoff Chain Limits:**
**There is no limit** on how many chained handoffs a workflow can contain. The documentation explicitly states: "There is no limit to how many chained Handoffs a workflow can have. You are free to create multiple Agents using diverse tools, models and handoffs, and orchestrate your own workflow using these Agents." ([Handoffs - Create an Agentic Workflow](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/agents/handoffs#create-an-agentic-workflow))

So you can freely chain agents together with handoffs—the constraint is just which two models you pick for each agent in your workflow.
